en.text: Sarah lived one hundred twenty-seven years. This was the length of Sarah’s life.

zhSimplified.text: 撒拉享寿一百二十七岁，这是撒拉一生的岁数。

zhTraditional.text: 撒拉享壽一百二十七歲，這是撒拉一生的歲數。

en.text: Sarah died in Kiriath Arba (also called Hebron), in the land of Canaan. Abraham came to mourn for Sarah, and to weep for her.

zhSimplified.text: 撒拉死在迦南地的基列·亚巴，就是希伯 。亚伯拉罕为她哀恸哭号。

zhTraditional.text: 撒拉死在迦南地的基列‧亞巴，就是希伯崙。亞伯拉罕為她哀慟哭號。

en.text: Abraham rose up from before his dead and spoke to the children of Heth, saying,

zhSimplified.text: 后来亚伯拉罕从死人面前起来，对赫人说：

zhTraditional.text: 後來亞伯拉罕從死人面前起來，對赫人說：

en.text: “I am a stranger and a foreigner living with you. Give me a possession of a burying-place with you, that I may bury my dead out of my sight.”

zhSimplified.text: 「我在你们中间是外人，是寄居的。求你们在这里给我一块地，我好埋葬我的死人，使她不在我眼前。」

zhTraditional.text: 「我在你們中間是外人，是寄居的。求你們在這裏給我一塊地，我好埋葬我的死人，使她不在我眼前。」

en.text: The children of Heth answered Abraham, saying to him,

zhSimplified.text: 赫人回答亚伯拉罕说：

zhTraditional.text: 赫人回答亞伯拉罕說：

en.text: “Hear us, my lord. You are a prince of God among us. Bury your dead in the best of our tombs. None of us will withhold from you his tomb. Bury your dead.”

zhSimplified.text: 「我主请听。你在我们中间是一位尊大的王子，只管在我们最好的坟地里埋葬你的死人；我们没有一人不容你在他的坟地里埋葬你的死人。」

zhTraditional.text: 「我主請聽。你在我們中間是一位尊大的王子，只管在我們最好的墳地裏埋葬你的死人；我們沒有一人不容你在他的墳地裏埋葬你的死人。」

en.text: Abraham rose up, and bowed himself to the people of the land, to the children of Heth.

zhSimplified.text: 亚伯拉罕就起来，向那地的赫人下拜，

zhTraditional.text: 亞伯拉罕就起來，向那地的赫人下拜，

en.text: He talked with them, saying, “If you agree that I should bury my dead out of my sight, hear me, and entreat for me to Ephron the son of Zohar,

zhSimplified.text: 对他们说：「你们若有意叫我埋葬我的死人，使她不在我眼前，就请听我的话，为我求琐辖的儿子以弗 ；

zhTraditional.text: 對他們說：「你們若有意叫我埋葬我的死人，使她不在我眼前，就請聽我的話，為我求瑣轄的兒子以弗崙，

en.text: that he may sell me the cave of Machpelah, which he has, which is in the end of his field. For the full price let him sell it to me among you as a possession for a burial place.”

zhSimplified.text: 把田头上那麦比拉洞给我；他可以按着足价卖给我，作我在你们中间的坟地。」

zhTraditional.text: 把田頭上那麥比拉洞給我，他可以按着足價賣給我，作我在你們中間的墳地。」

en.text: Now Ephron was sitting in the middle of the children of Heth. Ephron the Hittite answered Abraham in the hearing of the children of Heth, even of all who went in at the gate of his city, saying,

zhSimplified.text: 当时以弗 正坐在赫人中间。于是，赫人以弗 在城门出入的赫人面前对亚伯拉罕说：

zhTraditional.text: 當時以弗崙正坐在赫人中間。於是，赫人以弗崙在城門出入的赫人面前對亞伯拉罕說：

en.text: “No, my lord, hear me. I give you the field, and I give you the cave that is in it. In the presence of the children of my people I give it to you. Bury your dead.”

zhSimplified.text: 「不然，我主请听。我送给你这块田，连田间的洞也送给你，在我同族的人面前都给你，可以埋葬你的死人。」

zhTraditional.text: 「不然，我主請聽。我送給你這塊田，連田間的洞也送給你，在我同族的人面前都給你，可以埋葬你的死人。」

en.text: Abraham bowed himself down before the people of the land.

zhSimplified.text: 亚伯拉罕就在那地的人民面前下拜，

zhTraditional.text: 亞伯拉罕就在那地的人民面前下拜，

en.text: He spoke to Ephron in the audience of the people of the land, saying, “But if you will, please hear me. I will give the price of the field. Take it from me, and I will bury my dead there.”

zhSimplified.text: 在他们面前对以弗 说：「你若应允，请听我的话。我要把田价给你，求你收下，我就在那里埋葬我的死人。」

zhTraditional.text: 在他們面前對以弗崙說：「你若應允，請聽我的話。我要把田價給你，求你收下，我就在那裏埋葬我的死人。」

en.text: Ephron answered Abraham, saying to him,

zhSimplified.text: 以弗 回答亚伯拉罕说：

zhTraditional.text: 以弗崙回答亞伯拉罕說：

en.text: “My lord, listen to me. What is a piece of land worth four hundred shekels of silver between me and you? Therefore bury your dead.”

footnotes.text: 23:15 A shekel is about 10 grams, so 400 shekels would be about 4 kg. or 8.8 pounds.

zhSimplified.text: 「我主请听。值四百舍客勒银子的一块田，在你我中间还算什么呢？只管埋葬你的死人吧！」

zhTraditional.text: 「我主請聽。值四百舍客勒銀子的一塊田，在你我中間還算甚麼呢？只管埋葬你的死人吧！」

en.text: Abraham listened to Ephron. Abraham weighed to Ephron the silver which he had named in the hearing of the children of Heth, four hundred shekels of silver, according to the current merchants’ standard.

zhSimplified.text: 亚伯拉罕听从了以弗 ，照着他在赫人面前所说的话，把买卖通用的银子平了四百舍客勒给以弗 。

zhTraditional.text: 亞伯拉罕聽從了以弗崙，照着他在赫人面前所說的話，把買賣通用的銀子平了四百舍客勒給以弗崙。

en.text: So the field of Ephron, which was in Machpelah, which was before Mamre, the field, the cave which was in it, and all the trees that were in the field, that were in all of its borders, were deeded

zhSimplified.text: 于是，麦比拉、幔利前、以弗 的那块田和其中的洞，并田间四围的树木，

zhTraditional.text: 於是，麥比拉、幔利前、以弗崙的那塊田和其中的洞，並田間四圍的樹木，

en.text: to Abraham for a possession in the presence of the children of Heth, before all who went in at the gate of his city.

zhSimplified.text: 都定准归与亚伯拉罕，乃是他在赫人面前并城门出入的人面前买妥的。

zhTraditional.text: 都定準歸與亞伯拉罕，乃是他在赫人面前並城門出入的人面前買妥的。

en.text: After this, Abraham buried Sarah his wife in the cave of the field of Machpelah before Mamre (that is, Hebron), in the land of Canaan.

zhSimplified.text: 此后，亚伯拉罕把他妻子撒拉埋葬在迦南地幔利前的麦比拉田间的洞里。（幔利就是希伯 ）。

zhTraditional.text: 此後，亞伯拉罕把他妻子撒拉埋葬在迦南地幔利前的麥比拉田間的洞裏。（幔利就是希伯崙）。

en.text: The field, and the cave that is in it, were deeded to Abraham by the children of Heth as a possession for a burial place.

zhSimplified.text: 从此，那块田和田间的洞就借着赫人定准归与亚伯拉罕作坟地。

zhTraditional.text: 從此，那塊田和田間的洞就藉着赫人定準歸與亞伯拉罕作墳地。
